name: directives
description: Ontario Primary Care Paramedic medical directives, with every dose worked out for your patient. Live app: https://icpryde.github.io/Primary-Care-Paramedic-Directives/

scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android && npm run android:icon
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:icon && npm run ios:shell
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && npm run android:icon
scripts.ipa:update: npm run version:ios && npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap open ios
